retention_policy: Keep only the newest prerelease release page for SuperFW, BLUE and Original OMEGA; retain all git tags. Stable DE releases are untouched.

removed_release_pages.name: DSSMM SuperFW — Test 1 (Hardware Untested)
removed_release_pages.body:
## New features

- Manual Light/Dark themes and independent Blue, Green, Orange and Purple accents. New Chis setups start in Light; existing theme choices are retained.
- SD-browser artwork preview: press **Start** to cycle List → title artwork → box artwork. Use **UI settings → Save** to remember the mode.
- Name-matched [DSSCC](https://github.com/voluptuary/dsscc) artwork from mirrored folders and `CUSTOM` under `/SYSTEM/IMGS` and `/SYSTEM/IMGS2`, including marked transparency. Artwork uses a reduced color palette.

## New fixes

- Reject malformed artwork, incomplete reads and overlong or unsafe lookup paths; preserve opaque black in unmarked images.
- Cache artwork hits and misses to avoid repeated SD access for the same selection, and invalidate previews around directory changes and actions that can reuse memory.

## Summary of past features

- Based on [David Guillen Fandos’s SuperFW](https://github.com/davidgfnet/superfw), retaining its native game loading, patching, saving, cheats and game-dependent in-game menu/save states. NOR library support is available in the Chis variant. Bundled emulators remain upstream versions; this build does not include MiGoomba.
- This is the first DSSMM SuperFW prerelease. It is an early interface port, with further DS-style layout work ahead.

## Summary of past fixes

- Inherits the pinned SuperFW baseline; there is no earlier DSSMM SuperFW release history. Passing builds and software tests do not establish physical cartridge compatibility.

**Hardware testing:** the Chis build has been chain-loaded successfully on one SuperChis Prime v1.0. It reported SuperFW 0.22, and manual themes are available. The SD and Lite builds have not been tested on hardware. This is an initial smoke test, not full hardware qualification.

| Card | Download |
| --- | --- |
| SuperChis / SuperChis Prime (Prime v1.0 is the intended first test card) | `superfw-chis.fw` |
| SuperCard SD | `superfw-sd.fw` |
| SuperCard Lite | `superfw-lite.fw` |

The overall menu still uses the upstream SuperFW layout; the full DSSMM-style interface is still in development. Theme availability and successful chain-loading do not validate gameplay, saves, artwork rendering, NOR operations or installation. Back up your SD card, saves and current firmware. Review [upstream installation and recovery guidance](https://superfw.davidgf.net/docs/install/flash/) before any internal-flash write, confirm your recovery method, and never interrupt save or flash writes.

For step-by-step pack creation and installation, see [the artwork setup guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test1/superfw/docs/ARTWORK-SETUP.md). For a short hardware test checklist, see [the preview guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test1/superfw/docs/ARTWORK-PREVIEW.md). Folder artwork, GBA code-based packs, additional lookup fallbacks, NOR/recent previews and carousels are not implemented in this prototype. No automatic themes, hardware RTC or rumble controls are offered for Prime.

Credits: David Guillen Fandos/davidgfnet for SuperFW; ChisBread and collaborators for SuperChis hardware; Merkin for this port; DSSCC and its FrankieT19 DS Style scraper lineage for artwork tooling. Firmware and component license notices remain in the source.

removed_release_pages.name: DSSMM SuperFW — Test 2 (Hardware Validation Pending)
removed_release_pages.body:
## New features

- Chis now displays title artwork by default. Choose List, Title or Box in **UI settings**; Start in the browser still cycles through the views.
- Standard save, savestate and diagnostic files now live under `/SYSTEM`. The private `/.superfw` folder stays in place, and existing files in the old root folders remain usable.

## New fixes

- Older Chis UI settings migrate to the artwork default. Settings saved by this build retain an explicitly selected List mode.
- Existing root-level save sets and savestates are detected and continue using their original paths when no matching `/SYSTEM` copy exists. Nothing is moved or deleted automatically.

## Summary of past features

- Adds DSSCC-compatible name-matched title and box artwork from mirrored and `CUSTOM` folders, plus manual themes and color accents.
- Based on [David Guillen Fandos’s SuperFW](https://github.com/davidgfnet/superfw), retaining its native game loading, patching, saves, cheats, in-game menu and game save states. Chis includes NOR support. Bundled emulators remain upstream versions; this build does not include MiGoomba.
- The interface is still an early port. Consistent DSSMM styling across the browser, settings, system tools, game screens and in-game menus remains in development.

## Summary of past fixes

- Rejects malformed artwork, unsafe or overlong lookup paths and incomplete reads; caches previews to avoid repeated SD access and stale images.
- This is the second DSSMM SuperFW prerelease; earlier notes describe the initial artwork and theme work. Software checks do not establish cartridge compatibility.

**Hardware and validation:** the earlier Chis build chain-loaded on one SuperChis Prime v1.0 and reported SuperFW 0.22; manual themes were available. This build’s artwork display, default setting, save/state paths and broader interface have not been tested on hardware. SuperCard SD and Lite builds also remain untested. Hosted checks passed for all projects and all three SuperFW builds; local Chis, SD and Lite images were built and their headers and firmware seals verified.

Choose the download for your card: SuperChis/SuperChis Prime, SuperCard SD, or SuperCard Lite. Back up your SD card, saves and current firmware. Review [upstream installation and recovery guidance](https://superfw.davidgf.net/docs/install/flash/) before any internal-flash write, confirm your recovery method, and never interrupt save or flash writes. Existing legacy save files are left in place; see the [SYSTEM layout guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test2/superfw/docs/SYSTEM-LAYOUT.md) and [artwork setup guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test2/superfw/docs/ARTWORK-SETUP.md).

Credits: David Guillen Fandos/davidgfnet for SuperFW; ChisBread and collaborators for SuperChis hardware; Merkin for this port; DSSCC and its FrankieT19 DS Style scraper lineage for artwork tooling. Firmware and component license notices remain in the source.

removed_release_pages.body:
## New features

- DSSMM Light and Title artwork are now the defaults on SuperCard SD and SuperCard Lite as well as Chis, keeping the shared interface consistent across all three builds.
- All variants expose the same theme, accent and List/Title/Box settings, use the same artwork lookup and follow the same `/SYSTEM` save/state layout where supported.

## New fixes

- Older unversioned and version 1 UI settings migrate from the former native defaults to DSSMM Light and Title artwork on every board.
- Test 2 version 2 settings retain their saved choices, including an explicitly selected native theme or List view.

## Summary of past features

- Adds DSSCC-compatible name-matched title and box artwork, manual themes and color accents, plus grouped `/SYSTEM` save, state and diagnostic paths. The private `/.superfw` data remains separate.
- Based on [David Guillen Fandos’s SuperFW](https://github.com/davidgfnet/superfw), retaining its native game loading, patching, saves, cheats, in-game menu and game save states. NOR support is available on Chis. Bundled emulators remain upstream versions; this build does not include MiGoomba.
- The DSSMM browser treatment has begun, but consistent styling of all menus and game screens is still in development.

## Summary of past fixes

- Rejects malformed artwork and unsafe or incomplete file reads, and caches previews to avoid repeated SD access or stale images.
- Existing root-level saves and states remain usable when no matching `/SYSTEM` copy exists. Prior notes describe the first artwork and settings work.

**Hardware and validation:** all three variants passed hosted checks and were built for this prerelease, but the new SD/Lite defaults and artwork display have not been checked on those cards. No Test 3 changes have been physically validated. An earlier Chis image booted on one SuperChis Prime v1.0 and showed manual themes; that Test 1 smoke test does not establish Test 3 artwork, save/state or interface behavior. Chis-only NOR and other hardware-specific capabilities remain distinct.

Choose the download for your card: SuperChis/SuperChis Prime, SuperCard SD, or SuperCard Lite. Back up your SD card, saves and current firmware. Review [upstream installation and recovery guidance](https://superfw.davidgf.net/docs/install/flash/) before any internal-flash write, confirm your recovery method, and never interrupt save or flash writes. Existing legacy save files are left in place; see the [SYSTEM layout guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test3/superfw/docs/SYSTEM-LAYOUT.md) and [artwork setup guide](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/superfw-test3/superfw/docs/ARTWORK-SETUP.md).

Credits: David Guillen Fandos/davidgfnet for SuperFW; ChisBread and collaborators for SuperChis hardware; Merkin for this port; DSSCC and its FrankieT19 DS Style scraper lineage for artwork tooling. Firmware and component license notices remain in the source.

removed_release_pages.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.4.0 — BLUE Test 3 (Hardware Untested)
removed_release_pages.body:
**NEWER EZ-FLASH OMEGA DEFINITIVE EDITION B / BLUE ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED. UPDATE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

Do not install on the older DE Rev. A/B, Original OMEGA, or another model.

Software regression checks passed; installation, boot, saves, plugins, NOR timing and runtime stack peaks remain physically unverified. The larger split image still needs updater verification. Native 64 MiB support does not extend generic plugins beyond 32 MiB. Flash polling and SD/NOR power-loss limits remain; extra custom theme/color slots are excluded.

Back up the SD card and `.esv` saves. Old emulator save states are not guaranteed compatible; prefer in-game battery saves when transitioning.

### New features

- Replaced the built-in GB/GBC emulator with **MiGoomba v0.1** by **michyprima**, based on Jagoomba Color, Goomba Color and Goomba. The generic BLUE variant avoids unverified DE rumble register writes.

### New fixes

- Added embedded-emulator size/alignment guards and loader regression checks for exact game offsets, DMA copies and cache bounds.

### Summary of past features

- **FrankieT19's DS Style foundation and separate v8.0 interface work:** Start screen, themes, sounds, selection/launch effects, Auto theme, View grouping, Open SYSTEM, boot preferences and favorites behavior.
- List, List + Art and horizontal/vertical carousels, title/box art and side previews; favorites, recents, last-played startup, accent colors and readable settings.
- Name/header-code/mirrored artwork, long filenames, marked transparency and custom fallbacks; cached/scaled previews and optimized artwork lookup/rendering.
- Optional remembered cheats, off by default, by **exploitz86**, with collapsible groups from **SkillerCMP**, adapted by **exploitz86**; multilingual support including Thai/Chinese and a text/Markdown viewer.
- BLUE-native 64 MiB/5G handling, hardware drivers, in-game options and NOR allocation; themed NOR progress and SD-side NOR artwork paths.

### Summary of past fixes

- Bounded NES detection/patch writes, full-width cheat/save sizes and malformed marked artwork; corrected Chinese paths and stopped save loading on close errors.
- Checked game/plugin limits, SD reads/copies/closes, compressed payloads and stack-safe boot; restored small headerless plugins and directory records after failed loads.
- Safer staged saves/settings and filename checks; bounded PSRAM/NOR patch copies, consistent block padding, NOR erase/program/catalog readback and reserve-before-publish ordering.
- Preserved cheat-group selection/visible-row fixes and removed the black plugin-launch strip; checked kernel staging before replacing an update file.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**; and to **michyprima**, **Jaga / EvilJagaGenius**, **Dwedit** and **FluBBa** for the emulator lineage. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and provenance](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.4.0-blue-test3/ezfblue/CREDITS.md).

This project was developed with AI assistance.

- No new user-facing features; this build continued the BLUE software audit.

### New fixes

- Name/header/mirrored artwork, long filenames and marked transparency, optimized cached/scaled previews, remembered cheats/groups, themed NOR progress and SD-side NOR artwork paths; native 64 MiB/5G handling.

### Summary of past fixes

- Checked game/plugin limits and exact I/O, compressed/stack-safe boot, failed-load record rebuilding and staged save/settings replacement.
- Bounded PSRAM/NOR patch copies, FF padding and cheat data; verified NOR erase/program/catalog writes and reserve ordering, removed the black launch strip and checked update identity.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and lineage](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.3.1-blue-test2/CREDITS.md).

removed_release_pages.name: DS Style Merkin Mix 8.3.1 — Original OMEGA Test 3 (Hardware Untested)
removed_release_pages.body:
**ORIGINAL EZ-FLASH OMEGA ONLY — HARDWARE UNTESTED. UPDATE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** Do not install on DE Rev. A/B or the newer DE B / BLUE.

Source/build/host checks passed; installation, boot, saves, plugins, cheats/states and NOR still need cartridge testing. Native/plugin combinations remain limited to 32 MiB; NOR deletion retains the newest-title restriction. Flash success/polling and metadata power-loss recovery remain limited; extra custom theme/color slots are excluded.

Software mocks do not qualify physical flash timing, stack peaks or unusual inputs; artwork hints/cheat snapshots remain best-effort metadata.

Historical release; use the latest model-matched download unless comparing or recovering an older installation. Back up the SD card and saves.

### New features

- Freed 832 bytes of working RAM by keeping an unchanged built-in patch in read-only storage.

### New fixes

- Bounded NES detection and cartridge patch writes, including malformed input and NOR preparation.
- Corrected valid Chinese save/backup/artwork paths, tightened marked-art validation and stopped oversized/close-failed save loads before cartridge memory changes.

### Summary of past features

- **FrankieT19's Original OMEGA DS Style v8.0 foundation:** DS menus/Start, sounds, themes, selection/launch effects and animated carousels.
- List/List + Art and horizontal/vertical views, title/box art and side previews; favorites/recents, Light/Dark/Auto themes, accent colors, readable settings, Chinese/Thai and text/Markdown viewing.
- Name-matched/header/mirrored artwork, long filenames and marked transparency; Start/favorites/recent integration.
- Optional remembered cheats by **exploitz86**, with **SkillerCMP's** groups adapted by **exploitz86**; themed NOR progress.
- Optimized/indexed/cached artwork, CUSTOM Only corners, per-extension defaults, Clean list/wrap scopes, SD-side NOR artwork paths and refreshed splash/help.

### Summary of past fixes

- Checked game/plugin sizes, exact SD reads, PSRAM-bank and NOR patch boundaries; removed the black plugin-launch strip.
- Staged save/settings replacement, checked NOR space/catalog/scanning and FF padding; corrected collapsed-cheat selection and visible rows.
- Checked compressed plugin/decoder/argument handling and copies; corrected thumbnail reuse/VRAM bounds, Thai labels and popup hints, with directory rebuilds after failed loads.

Thanks to **FrankieT19**, **EZ-FLASH**, **Sterophonick**, **exploitz86**, **SkillerCMP**, **aidiadayo**, **Kekun** and **ChaN**. Merkin Mix artwork and port work is maintained by **Merkin / voluptuary**. [Credits and lineage](https://github.com/voluptuary/dssmm/blob/v8.3.1-omega-test3/CREDITS.md).
